run_mapping.restructure, the structure part of restr: STUDIO_LAYER_CREATED when a write creates a layer, else STUDIO_LAYER_MUTATED; artifacts = the layers
run_mapping.open_import, open_import_detailed: STUDIO_DOCUMENT_CREATED then STUDIO_IMPORT_COMPLETED (sequences 0, 1 of the open revision); every import route converts a foreign file into a new native document with a fresh SDOC id (no native passthrough in convert_to_native); the import record now carries the document.import command context
run_mapping.undo, redo (chronicle, timeline, multica: STUDIO_HISTORY_UNDONE / STUDIO_HISTORY_REDONE, causation = the reversed step's correlation (ATTRIBUTION-1's context)
run_mapping.play_action: each inner commit emits its own event with causation = the action's correlation; the action context is now minted before the steps (base revision = the revision before the action) and taken by the action_play record, success or refusal
run_mapping.entry part of *_and_entry (token map): develop -> STUDIO_RAW_DEVELOPED, text -> STUDIO_TEXT_EDITED, vector -> STUDIO_VECTOR_PATH_EDITED (not repeated when the path part already emitted it); revision = the document revision after the step (an entry write itself makes no chronicle revision)
run_mapping.unmapped entry tokens: selection (view state), composition, motion, audio_routing, waveform_edit, multicam, proof, design, info: no single catalog variant, emit nothing
run_mapping.set_document_entry (public, no op record: emits nothing: no record to carry the outcome and no receipt; listed
run_mapping.submit_sequence*, submit_sequence_edits*: nothing: timeline/audio commits have no catalog family (spec-delta request below)
run_mapping.emission rule: only when the session accepted the commit with a new revision (Applied.changed and not replayed); refusals and no-change edits emit nothing (test refused_and_unchanged_commits_emit_nothing_and_no_sink_is_recorded)
run_mapping.rollback cases: a *_and_entry step whose entry write is refused keeps the accepted commit's event (in that step's record) and its rollback undo emits STUDIO_HISTORY_UNDONE in the undo record: accepted events are never coalesced away (STU-CON-010)

notes.event_identity: event id = document@revision#sequence (sequence = 0-based index of the event within that revision), not document#sequence as the brief proposed: a per-Run sequence restarts in every Run and would collide across Runs on the same document; revisions are unique per document under one authority, so the id is deterministic and collision-free while histories do not diverge, and a divergent reuse meets the sink's immutable-envelope collision refusal
notes.spec_delta_request: STU-CON-003/014 have no family for timeline and audio commits (submit_sequence*, submit_sequence_edits*: mixer, trim, nest, multicam); request a studio.timeline (or studio.audio) catalog row so they can emit; until then they emit nothing
